###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to confirm in their own words that they understand and tested the change; a triager may also want to decide how to handle the overlap with #39758.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the screenshots! Could you reply in your own words confirming that you've read the [AI policy](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html#ai-use-policy-and-guidelines) and explaining how you tested this change yourself? Please also move the screenshots into the PR description, and note that there's another open PR (#39758) for this issue.
```
